messages.subject: MSStats quantification
parts:
Dear MSStats,

I would like to know if it is possible to run the quantification directly after the data processing (using dataProcess function). If my end purpose is to get the sample quantification matrix for external downstream analysis, if it's possible to skip the groupcomparison, etc directly to go to sample quantification.

Thanks a lot for your kind advice.


Gene
Aebersold group

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: MSStats quantification
parts:
Dear Gene,

Yes. you can use the quantification function after data processing. If you use '?quantification' in R, it will show you that the input for quantification function is output of dataProcess function. 
If you have further question about quantification function, please let me know.

Thanks,

Meena
